title: Frozen Factor or Spectral Band? In LoRA, the Factor Matters More at Low Rank
abstract: arXiv:2610.06621v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On two main task-model pairs, at ranks 1 to 8 with few optimiser steps, the factor a LoRA variant freezes matters more than its band of singular directions. MiCA and PiCa are compared by band, minor against dominant, yet MiCA freezes the output factor B and PiCa, in our notation, the input factor A. We cross factor and band in a 2 x 2 design on models from 1B to 8B parameters. Freezing A beats freezing B on both bands, by +12 to +20 points at rank 2 on a format task, our primary evidence, and still by about +7 points at rank 8 on OpenBookQA. A Holm correction over 258 primary tests, added post hoc, keeps this advantage in 15 of 16 tests and the lead of factor over band at ranks 1, 2 and 4, rank 1 of the format task being itself post hoc. At rank 8 that lead passes its own test but not the correction. The advantage repeats at rank 2 with two 7B models, by +11 to +13 points. Outside the correction, it repeats on GSM8K with a 1B m

translated_title: 冻结因子还是频谱带？在LoRA中，低秩时因子更为重要
translated_abstract: 在两个主要的任务-模型组合上，在秩1到8、优化器步数较少的设置下，LoRA变体所冻结的因子比其奇异方向带更为重要。MiCA和PiCa通常按频谱带（次主导与主导奇异方向）来比较，但在我们的记号下，MiCA冻结输出因子B，而PiCa冻结输入因子A。我们在1B到8B参数规模的模型上，通过2x2交叉实验设计同时考察了因子和带两个维度。在两个带上，冻结A均优于冻结B：在格式任务（我们的主要证据）的秩2上提升12到20个百分点，在OpenBookQA的秩8上仍提升约7个百分点。事后补充的针对258项主要检验的Holm校正显示，这一优势在16项检验中的15项中依然成立，且因子相对于带的优势在秩1、2和4上保持领先（格式任务的秩1本身也是事后检验）。在秩8上，该优势通过了自身检验但未通过校正检验。该优势在秩2上用两个7B模型得到重复验证，提升11到13个百分点。在校正之外，该优势还在GSM8K上用1B模型得到了重复（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文通过2x2交叉实验设计发现，在低秩（1-8）少步数设置下，LoRA变体冻结哪个因子（输入因子A显著优于输出因子B）比其选择的奇异方向带（主导或次主导）对性能影响更大。
en_tdlr: Through a 2×2 cross-design, this paper shows that at low ranks (1–8) with few optimizer steps, which factor a LoRA variant freezes (input factor A over output factor B) matters more for performance than its band of singular directions (dominant vs. minor).
